about: The Decency Press (docs/worlds/05_DECENCY_PRESS.md, 'The same night'): on the radio, Swyne names a club in the Old Quarter at the Decency Committee, and Vesper doesn't deny it.

card.title: THE DECENCY COMMITTEE
card.body: Councillor Swyne named "a certain club in the Old Quarter" before the Council's Decency Committee tonight. Its proprietor, called to answer, did not deny it.
